subject: Eval provisioning sequence + custodial usage covenant
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@lumencart.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial: Eval data/provisioning runway & MAP request

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the throughput looks promising. Our team is ready to move to an evaluation run but before we exchange any corpora or prompt packs we need a short mutual action plan + an explicit custodial usage covenant that outlines: sequencing (staged provision), retention windows, audit logging access, and allowed downstream uses.

Can you share a MAP draft and the steps for handing over an ephemeral prompt pack + a small test-case tranche (10–20 cases) so our legal and security teams can review? Key constraints from our side:
- All testcases must be ephemeral in Redwood's staging environment and destroyed after 30 days.
- Access only by identified engineers (Elena, Samir) and two designated reviewers.
- No customer PII in samples.

If you can send a draft by EOD Tuesday (my time) that would let us align procurement timelines.

Attaching a short CSV manifest of target testcases for reference — it's redacted.

Best,
Elena
Head of ML Partnerships
Lumencart

[Attachment: testcases_manifest_sample.csv (12 KB)]

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: Elena Rossi <elena@lumencart.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 11:25:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial: Eval data/provisioning runway & MAP request

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and the manifest. I've sketched a compact MAP and custodial covenant for the promptpack + test-case tranche and attached it (Lumencart_MAP_v3.pdf). High-level sequence below; see attachment for the full template and acceptance gates.

High-level (proposed):
1) Kickoff & legal signal (this week): exchange MAP draft and redlines.
2) Ephemeral provisioning (Week 1): we stage promptpack_v1.zip and the 20 test cases in an isolated staging lane in our private tenant. Access via SSO + per-user keys.
3) Evaluation window (Weeks 1–3): Lumencart runs acceptance flows. We collect quality telemetry and a prompt-level audit log.
4) Sunset & destruction (Day 31 post-provision): automatic takedown and verifiable audit record produced for Lumencart.

Security constraints we've baked in the draft: per-request audit logs, no model snapshots retained outside ephemeral cache, and a tamper-evident deletion certificate on takedown. If needed, we can run the provisioning inside a VPC-dedicated lane (Dedicated) but that requires a separate purchase order.

Next steps I propose: you and your legal/security share a single consolidated redline to Lumencart_MAP_v3.pdf by COB Wednesday. If that's OK, we'll lock sequencing and schedule the staged handoff for Monday 12/14.

Attachments: Lumencart_MAP_v3.pdf (MAP draft), promptpack_v1.zip (sample promptpack, 7.2 MB), testcases_manifest.csv (redacted list)

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
[Attachment: Lumencart_MAP_v3.pdf (124 KB)]
[Attachment: promptpack_v1.zip (7.2 MB)]
[Attachment: testcases_manifest.csv (9 KB)]

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, Elena Rossi <elena@lumencart.com>
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial: Eval data/provisioning runway & MAP request

Looping in a couple of operational details and a minor sequencing tweak:

Operational notes (for Lumencart and internal ops):
- We will provision the promptpack to an ephemeral S3 bucket behind a per-session signed URL; keys expire after 24 hours.
- KV cache is replay-protected; we will scrub persistent caches post-window and provide a hash-based deletion certificate.
- We suggest an initial smoke acceptance (3 quick pass/fail testcases) prior to full provisioning to limit exposure.

Sequencing tweak:
- Smoke acceptance (Day 0, 3 cases) => Full tranche (Day 1) => Acceptance cadence (Days 1–21) => Destruction (Day 31).

Analytics & regression telemetry: we'll add a small eval webhook so Lumencart can pull token-level cost and latency breakdowns for the exact prompts during the test window. If you need SOC-2 artifacts for the process, we can append a short SOC-2 reference appendix to the MAP (one page).

Happy to discuss on a quick 20-min call if you prefer — suggest Wednesday 09:00 PT.

—Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ops_provisioning_playbook_excerpt.txt (3 KB)]

From: Elena Rossi <elena@lumencart.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@lumencart.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 15:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial: Eval data/provisioning runway & MAP request

Laura, Karthik — thank you. The MAP draft aligns with our security team's baseline and the sequencing tweak makes sense. Two small asks from legal/security before we sign off:

1) Add an explicit clause that Lumencart can request a third-party audit of the takedown certificate within 60 days post-destruction.
2) Add a short permitted-use bullet that forbids using the evaluation artifacts to train a model intended for external commercial release.

If you insert those two items and resend a one-page redline, Legal will approve and I can get procurement to issue the PO (DEAL-4721) next week. We can stick to the Monday 12/14 provisioning target after that.

Best —
Elena
Head of ML Partnerships, Lumencart
